rule: each dot may move <= 2 px onto the strongest smoothed magnetic-edge response in its window, subject to a 0.25 sigma gain gate and a 2.828 px spacing floor; count, mass and catalogue exclusion unchanged

model.hypothesis: A dot's 100 m position is uncertain by about the kernel radius, so moving it up to 2 px onto the local maximum of the horizontal magnetic gradient recovers true-trace credit the kernel currently only half-credits.
model.mechanism: Faults and their damage zones truncate or offset magnetised units, so the horizontal gradient of TMI peaks along the structure. The grader gives a triangular credit max(1-d/3px,0), so a dot displaced 2 px from truth keeps only 0.33 of its unit credit; the same dot re-centred earns ~1.0.
model.confounder: Magnetic contacts with no Quaternary slip (intrusive contacts, remanence boundaries, survey seams between flight-line blocks) produce the same gradient peak; so do shallow alluvial magnetic contrasts.
model.falsifier: Live change <= -0.02 kills the positional-correction reading (the dots were already on true traces and the gradient peak is a mimicking contact); |change| < 0.01 is no evidence in either direction.

predicted_live_range: MODEL: live change in [-0.005, +0.015], central +0.004. Below the 0.01 evidence floor this is a mechanism probe, not a score play.
